text:
```yaml
name: E2E Kind PR

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-kind-pr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install playwright
        playwright install

    - name: Run UI tests on Kind
      run: |
        ./scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh kind
        npx playwright show-report

    - name: Debugging tips for Kind
      run: |
        echo "To debug UI tests on Kind:"
        echo "- Ensure Kind cluster is running"
        echo "- Check logs using 'kubectl logs <pod-name>'"
        echo "- Use 'kubectl port-forward' if needed"

    - name: Run UI tests on Hypershift
      run: |
        ./scripts/91-run-ui-tests.sh hypershift
        npx playwright show-report

    - name: Debugging tips for Hypershift
      run: |
        echo "To debug UI tests on Hypershift:"
        echo "- Ensure Hypershift cluster is running"
        echo "- Check logs using 'oc logs <pod-name>'"
        echo "- Handle TLS issues by setting appropriate environment variables"
        echo "- Retrieve credentials using 'oc get secret <secret-name> -o jsonpath='{.data.token}' | base64 --decode'"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/e2e-kind-pr.yaml` sets up a pipeline to run end-to-end UI tests using Playwright in a Kind Kubernetes cluster and a Hypershift environment. It includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Python, installing dependencies, running UI tests, and providing debugging tips for each environment. The workflow ensures that the UI tests are integrated into the CI process and that the instructions are consistent across different environments.
